description: This file defines the ADODB_Pager class, which provides pagination functionality for displaying database records with navigation controls such as first, previous, next, last, and page links. It is used to paginate and render database recordsets in web applications.

classes.name: ADODB_Pager
classes.description: A class providing pagination controls for database recordsets, including navigation links and grid rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the pager with database connection, SQL query, and configuration options.

methods.name: Render_First
methods.description: Displays a link to the first page of records.

methods.name: render_next
methods.description: Displays a link to navigate to the next page.

methods.name: render_last
methods.description: Displays a link to navigate to the last page.

methods.name: render_pagelinks
methods.description: Displays a series of page number links for navigation.

methods.name: render_prev
methods.description: Displays a link to navigate to the previous page.

methods.name: RenderGrid
methods.description: Renders the current recordset as an HTML grid/table.

methods.name: RenderNav
methods.description: Builds and returns the navigation bar with pagination links.

methods.name: RenderPageCount
methods.description: Displays the current page and total page count.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main method to load data and render the full pagination layout.

methods.name: RenderLayout
methods.description: Controls the overall layout of the pagination component, can be overridden for custom formatting.
